propositions: Fuzzy ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes are unreliable for deterministic LLM gate behavior and must be replaced with closed kind sets mapping to blocking vs. advisory outcomes.

The undecomposed axis must convert to three kinds: bundles_separable_slices (advisory, 0.55), missing_required_child (blocking, 0.85), no_executable_breakdown (blocking, 0.85), and dod_uncertifiable must convert to three kinds: underspecified_certification (advisory, 0.55), uncertifiable_outcome (blocking, 0.85), certification_cannot_prove (blocking, 0.85).
The inert G5-suppressor hedge (veto_undecomposed_g5, fired zero times) must be removed from both verifier prompts and descriptions, with no version bump.

All three callers of these axes in impact_plan (contribs MAX, has_override floor loop, dod_uncertifiable amplifier) must be rewritten to use the new kind-set maps; the axes must be added to _PLAN_GRADED_AXES.
The IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must be bumped from plan-v4 to plan-v5 in one batch covering both conversions plus margin telemetry, per ADR 0054 section 4.

A zero-LLM re-score script must validate the conversion against 22,667 recorded findings and confirm no unjustified blocks are lost; the script and audit must land in docs/calibration/ with reproducibility guaranteed via legacy_impact_plan() baseline.
